releaseNotes.headline: Cursor shows your current plan
releaseNotes.summary: Version 0.2.18 checks Cursor's current account plan instead of trusting the editor's saved membership.

highlights.title: Current account plan
highlights.detail: Cursor's plan label refreshes from its account service with each usage check.

highlights.title: No stale Pro label
highlights.detail: An old Pro membership cached by the editor no longer determines the displayed plan.

highlights.title: Usage stays visible
highlights.detail: If the plan lookup is unavailable, current usage remains visible and the plan label is omitted.
